summary: AIG filed an 8-K reporting its second-quarter 2026 results and declared a $0.50 per share cash dividend. The press release highlights General Insurance NPW of $7.5 billion (up 9%), underwriting income of $686 million, combined ratio of 89.0%, net income per diluted share of $1.78, and adjusted after-tax income of $2.00. AIG returned $904 million to shareholders in the quarter (including $641 million buybacks and $263 million dividends). With no special-situation catalyst such as M&A, restructuring, or strategic review, this is routine earnings reporting. What to watch: continued capital return pace and any future Corebridge stake sales.
